conclusion: Parsing and caller-local copying of a selected HSACO code range is a metadata/materialization boundary, not code-object transport or gem5 execution.
decision: Keep PT_LOAD mapping, descriptor upload, dynamic AQL/kernarg construction, wire capability negotiation, and ISA execution as the next separate gate.
invalidated_assumptions: A byte-exact local code copy proves that the existing handwritten CP-0008 bridge can execute the HSACO.
observation: The runtime binding explicitly marks metadata-only and requires-code-object-transport flags, while the gem5 wire remains fixture-only and no PT_LOAD/AQL execution evidence exists.
question_or_symptom: What does the new runtime API actually prove about HSACO execution?
